what_it_does: Hosted ecommerce platform for online stores, POS and multichannel selling.
auth_notes: Admin API tokens via OAuth (authorization code / token exchange) for Dev Dashboard apps; client credentials grant only for stores in the developer's own organization (tokens expire after 24h). Storefront API uses public/private tokens.
access_notes: Partner/merchant accounts can create dev stores from the Dev Dashboard (up to 250 per org) for testing; docs do not state a fee for dev stores and only note test payments. Protected customer data (PII fields) requires a separate access request.
api_notes: GraphQL Admin API (products, orders, customers, inventory, fulfillment, etc.), Storefront API, Customer Account API, Partner API; legacy REST Admin API.
human_needed: create Partner/Dev Dashboard account and dev store; request protected customer data access for PII fields

what_it_does: Open-source WordPress plugin for running online stores.
auth_notes: Per-store REST API consumer key/secret (created in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API or via /wc-auth/v1/authorize app flow); Basic auth over HTTPS, OAuth 1.0a one-legged HMAC signing over HTTP. Each connection needs the store's own base URL.
access_notes: Store owner generates keys in their own WordPress admin; a developer can self-host a free WordPress+WooCommerce test site.
api_notes: WC REST API v3: products, orders, customers, coupons, refunds, reports, taxes, shipping, webhooks, settings.

what_it_does: SaaS ecommerce platform for B2C and B2B online stores.
auth_notes: App-level API accounts (Developer Portal) get per-store tokens via OAuth install flow; store-level API accounts give a static X-Auth-Token; account-level accounts for GraphQL Account API.
access_notes: Free trial store available via bigcommerce.com/free-trial; partners can create Partner Use Sandboxes in the Partner Portal. Trial length not confirmed in docs opened.
api_notes: REST Management APIs (catalog, orders, customers, carts, checkouts, webhooks, etc.), GraphQL Storefront API, GraphQL Account/Admin APIs.
human_needed: sign up for trial store or partner sandbox

what_it_does: Enterprise B2C commerce platform from Salesforce for large retailers.
auth_notes: Shopper APIs use SLAS (OAuth 2.1, e.g. private client credentials); Admin APIs use Account Manager OAuth tokens/API clients.
access_notes: Requires a B2C Commerce instance or on-demand sandbox; sandboxes need purchased sandbox credits, a realm ID from an Account Executive/CSM, and Account Manager roles. No free trial or developer edition found.
api_notes: B2C Commerce API (SCAPI): Shopper APIs (catalog, baskets, orders, customers) and Admin APIs (products, orders, inventory); also legacy OCAPI.
human_needed: obtain B2C Commerce realm/sandbox via Salesforce customer or partner contract

what_it_does: Self-hosted or Adobe-hosted enterprise ecommerce platform (Magento Open Source/Adobe Commerce).
auth_notes: Admin/customer bearer tokens, or Integration (OAuth 1.0a) credentials; session auth for storefront JS. Per-store base URL. Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service (SaaS) uses separate IMS-based auth (not confirmed in detail).
access_notes: Store admins create integrations/tokens themselves. Magento Open Source is likely free to self-host but not confirmed in docs opened; Adobe Commerce itself is a licensed product.
api_notes: REST, SOAP and GraphQL web APIs covering catalog, orders, customers, inventory, carts, CMS.
main_blocker: per-store self-hosted URL; Adobe Commerce license for paid edition

what_it_does: Website builder with built-in ecommerce for small businesses.
auth_notes: API keys for custom applications (Commerce Advanced plan); OAuth for Extensions requires registering at account.squarespace.com/developer-apps and Squarespace review/approval.
access_notes: API keys require the Commerce Advanced plan; OAuth client must be reviewed and approved by Squarespace.
api_notes: Commerce APIs: Inventory, Orders, Products, Profiles, Transactions, Webhook Subscriptions.
main_blocker: paid plan required; OAuth client approval
human_needed: buy Commerce Advanced plan or get OAuth client approved
